topic: 地点、方向与正在发生的事
grammarFocus: there is / are；地点介词；现在进行时；祈使句入门。
title: At the Train Station
instructions: 阅读短文，然后回答问题。请仔细阅读短文，答案必须来自短文。
passage: This is a small train station. There is a big clock above the door. There are many people here. A woman is standing near the ticket machine. She is buying a ticket. Two children are sitting on a bench. They are eating apples. A man is walking to the platform. He is carrying a bag. The train is coming. Please stand behind the yellow line. Do not run. The train is at the platform now. The doors are open. People are getting on the train. The woman is on the train. The children are on the train too. The man is on the train. The train is leaving. Goodbye!

questions.explanation: 短文说“There is a big clock above the door.”，所以钟在门上方。
questions.evidence: There is a big clock above the door.

questions.explanation: 短文说“A woman is standing near the ticket machine.”，所以她在售票机附近。
questions.evidence: A woman is standing near the ticket machine.

questions.explanation: 短文说“Two children are sitting on a bench. They are eating apples.”，所以孩子们在吃苹果。
短文说“A man is walking to the platform.”，所以他正走向站台。
questions.evidence: A man is walking to the platform.

questions.explanation: 短文说“Please stand behind the yellow line.”，所以请站在黄线后面。
questions.evidence: Please stand behind the yellow line.

questions.prompt: 短文说不要做什么？请用短文中的词填空：Do not ______.
questions.explanation: 短文说“Do not run.”，所以填 run。

questions.prompt: 火车现在在哪里？请用短文中的词填空：The train is at the ______ now.
questions.explanation: 短文说“The train is at the platform now.”，所以填 platform。
questions.evidence: The train is at the platform now.

questions.prompt: 那个女人现在在哪里？请用短文中的词填空：The woman is on the ______.
questions.explanation: 短文说“The woman is on the train.”，所以填 train。
questions.evidence: The woman is on the train.

grammar.title: There is / There are; 地点介词; 现在进行时; 祈使句
grammar.explanation: 我们用 there is 表示单数名词的存在，用 there are 表示复数名词的存在。地点介词如 above（在上方）、near（在附近）、on（在……上）、behind（在……后面）用来描述位置。现在进行时表示正在发生的动作，结构是 be（am/is/are）+ 动词-ing。祈使句用来发出指令，以动词原形开头，如 Stand... / Do not run.
grammar.example: There is a big clock above the door. The train is coming. Please stand behind the yellow line.

questions.prompt: 选择正确的句子描述图片：一个男孩正在读书。
options: The boy is reading a book.
The boy are reading a book.
answers: The boy is reading a book.
questions.explanation: 现在进行时结构是 be + 动词-ing。主语 the boy 是单数，用 is，所以选“The boy is reading a book.”。

questions.prompt: 选择正确的句子：桌子上有一些书。
options: There are some books on the table.
There is some books on the table.
There are some books in the table.
answers: There are some books on the table.
questions.explanation: books 是复数，用 there are；在桌子上用介词 on。所以选“There are some books on the table.”。

questions.prompt: 选择正确的祈使句：请开门。
questions.explanation: 祈使句以动词原形开头，表示请求时加 please。所以选“Open the door, please.”。

questions.prompt: 选择正确的句子：猫在椅子下面。
options: The cat is under the chair.
The cat is on the chair.
The cat is in the chair.
answers: The cat is under the chair.
questions.explanation: 在……下面用介词 under。所以选“The cat is under the chair.”。
